product.title: American Dream One Day Fun Day Dreamworks Waterpark 4-in-1 Pass

description.text: Enjoy a fun and interactive day at American Dream Mall just across the river from Manhattan in New Jersey. There, you'll have passes to do four incredible activities, museums, and theme parks for a fun-filled day, maximizing your time and money. Get wet at DreamWorks Water Park, take a swing at Blacklight Mini Golf, make your way through the Mirror Maze, and take amazing photos at TiLT Museum.

highlights: Escape Manhattan and spend an immersive day at American Dream
Passes to four interactive attractions are included
Pre-paid tickets ensure entry to all four attractions any time during opening hours
Have four unique experiences in one memorable day, on your own schedule
inclusions: All Access Pass to DreamWorks Water Park
